document: Bachelor of Arts & Technology in Interaction Design at Hogeschool voor de Kunsten Utrecht (2006-2010). Studied audiovisual design, animation, game programming, software development, electronics and robotics, usability and user testing, and graphic design. Thesis: Product development journey — research and design models for user-centered products.
